snippet.title: Surf's Up - Nintendo DS Gameplay High Resolution (DeSmuME)
snippet.description:
Surf's Up - Nintendo DS Gameplay High Resolution (DeSmuME)

Subscribe for more videos: https://goo.gl/rysf1n
JohnGodgamesHD Channel subscribe: https://goo.gl/W9f1n4
Visit us at http://www.godgames-world.com for more


Surf's Up is the video game based on the Sony Pictures Animation film of the same name. Surf's Up the video game follows the basic story of Cody Maverick in the movie. This game was developed by Ubisoft and is available for PC and for various console platforms.

A signature feature has Shia LaBeouf, Jeff Bridges, Zooey Deschanel, Mario Cantone, Diedrich Bader, and Sal Masekela reprising their roles from the movie.

An Xbox port for the game was announced but was canceled due to low sales for the system.




Used a dev build - DeSmuME 0.9.12 git#192e0f88

Enhanced graphics with emulator DeSmuME.
- recording sw Nvidia Share.
- some games can have graphical issues, lags and other problems...

https://ci.appveyor.com/project/zeromus/desmume/build/artifacts

CPU - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X @ 4.8 Ghz Stock
RAM - G.SKILL 32GB DDR4 3600MHz CL16
GPU - GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER GAMING OC 8G
OS - Windows 10 64bit
